items.t: Announced plans to filibuster a Republican-led redistricting bill.
items.q: Texas Democratic state Sen. Carol Alvarado announced plans Friday to filibuster a Republican-led redistricting bill

items.t: Co-chaired the Select Committee on Transparency in State Agency Operations while serving in the Texas House of Representatives.
items.q: In 2008, she was elected to the Texas House of Representatives and served five terms representing District 145. She served as the Chair of the Urban Affairs Committee and Co-Chair of the Select Committee on Transparency in State Agency Operations.

record.t: Held a fifteen-hour filibuster in the Texas Senate against a bill that opponents said would negatively impact citizens' right to vote.
record.q: Ultimately, Alvarado spoke against the bill for fifteen hours, ceding the floor just before 9 a.m. on Thursday morning.

record.t: Was first elected to Texas Senate District 6 in a 2018 special election.
record.q: Senator Carol Alvarado is proud to serve Texas Senate District 6 in Harris County and was first elected in a 2018 Special Election.

record.t: Was elected to the Texas House of Representatives (2008).

record.t: Held a 15-hour filibuster on the Senate floor in an effort to derail a bill.
record.q: State Senator Carol Alvarado (D) kicked off her long-shot efforts to derail the bill with a 15-hour filibuster on the floor on Wednesday.
